name: DOUBLE CHOP KNEE UPS
introduce: Stand with your left foot forward. Lift your arms overhead and interlock your hands. \n\nLift your right knee and lower your hands to the outside of your right thigh. Do it twice, then switch side and repeat.

tips.text: Please keep your upper body straight.
Exhale as you lift your knee, and inhale as you lower it.
This exercise works your core, and it can also get your heart rate up.
